title: QBR narrative threads and decision anchors — concise board pack
creator: Aisha Malik
description:
Purpose: Create a compact, narrative-driven QBR/board packet that presents a clear product trajectory, the customer and reliability metrics that matter, trade-offs we plan to make (cost vs latency vs coverage), and three explicit decision asks for executives.

Audience: CEO, CFO, Head of Product, Head of Engineering, Board members. Packet must be consumable as a slide deck + 1‑page one-pager (for board pre-read).

Scope: This ticket captures the PM-owned content and decision framing for the product section of the QBR. It synthesizes inputs from Eng (serving/runtime), Design (dashboard visuals), Sales/CS (top customers and asks), and Finance (impact model). The goal is to: 1) highlight progress vs OKRs, 2) call out specific risks and mitigation plans, and 3) surface concrete asks with expected economics and trade-offs.

Structure we intend to deliver:
- Executive summary (1 slide + 1 pager) with top-line recommendations and 3 decision anchors.
- Trajectory heatmap (product initiatives vs adoption & effort).
- Metrics dashboard snapshot: latency P50/P95, cost per 1M tokens, uptime/SLO, monthly active API keys, revenue-attributed usage.
- Risk & mitigation table (operational, model quality, supply constraints).
- Ask appendix: staffing, Dedicated capacity budget increase, Private pilot approval and acceptance criteria.

Notes on constraints and trade-offs: We must keep the deck <12 slides. Finance requires an incremental TCO estimate for Dedicated capacity (3-year view) with sensitivity to model mix (large vs trimmed quantized variants). Engineering requested a defer window for two kernel-level optimizations to avoid scope overrun for this quarter. Design requests final assets by 2025-02-21 to meet the production deadline for the board packet.
